meta.title: Mind Hub — AI Diary & Notes
meta.description: Mind Hub is a diary, notes, journal, calendar, code projects and tables app with an AI assistant that keeps them for you. Support, contact and account help.
meta.ogDescription: A diary and notes your AI keeps for you.
hero.title: A diary and notes your AI keeps for you
hero.lead:
Mind Hub brings your diary, notes, journal, calendar, code projects and tables together —
            with an AI assistant that can write, organise and update them when you ask.
hero.badge: Coming soon to the App Store
features.title: Everything in one place
features.lead: Each part works on its own, and the AI chat connects them.
features.chat.title: AI chat
features.chat.text: Ask about your notes and plans. Attach notes, projects, tables, photos or files, or dictate by voice. The assistant can draft notes, projects and tables or update diary pages — nothing is saved until you tap.
features.diary.title: Diary
features.diary.text: Your day, your layout: write, draw and drop in photos anywhere on the grid, start from a template and change anything. Share a page as an image.
features.notes.title: Notes
features.notes.text: Text and project notes in folders: formatting, checklists, lists, photos, files, audio, drawings, tables and reminders.
features.calendar.title: Calendar
features.calendar.text: Year and month views with a day timeline. Timed and repeating notes, events from your device’s calendar, add a note to your calendar.
features.journal.title: Journal
features.journal.text: A chat with yourself: messages, photos, videos, voice and files, links to your notes and projects, search.
features.projects.title: Projects
features.projects.text: Build small web pages in HTML, CSS and JavaScript and run them right on your iPhone or iPad.
features.tables.title: Tables & charts
features.tables.text: Spreadsheets with formulas, several sheets and cell styles; bar, line, area and pie charts; export to Excel.
features.backup.title: Backup & more
features.backup.text: Export everything to one file and restore it on a new device. Reminders, dark mode and six languages.
tour.title: A closer look
tour.lead: What each part of Mind Hub does today.
tour.chat.title: An assistant that works with your notes
tour.chat.sub: Talk to it like a person — it reads what you share and prepares changes you approve.
tour.chat.tick1: Attach anything: notes, projects, tables, photos, camera shots and files.
tour.chat.tick2: It does the work: creates notes, projects and tables, updates diary pages — saved only when you tap.
tour.chat.tick3: Full control: stop, copy, regenerate or edit a message and flip between versions.
tour.chat.tick4: Dictation and a history of all your chats.
mock.chat.me: Make a packing list for the weekend trip from my notes
mock.chat.ai: Here is a checklist based on “Trip plans”. Save it as a new note?
tour.diary.title: Your day, your layout
tour.diary.sub: Start from a blank grid or a template, then change anything — tomorrow’s page can look nothing like today’s.
tour.diary.tick1: Blocks on a grid: text, styled text, images, drawings, projects and floating text.
tour.diary.tick2: Templates: pick one, edit it or save your own.
tour.diary.tick3: A photo of the day and a gallery of every filled day.
tour.diary.tick4: Swipe between days and share a page as an image.
mock.diary.text: Morning run, 5 km. Finally finished the landing page. Coffee with Anna at 4.
tour.notes.title: Notes that hold everything
tour.notes.sub: Quick text notes and rich project notes, organised in folders.
tour.notes.tick1: Formatting: fonts, sizes, colours, background, checklists and numbered lists.
tour.notes.tick2: Project notes with photos, files, video, audio, drawings, tables and embedded projects.
tour.notes.tick3: Folders with drag and drop, search and filters.
tour.notes.tick4: Reminders and export: text notes to Markdown, project notes to Word or PDF.
mock.notes.title: Launch checklist
tour.calendar.title: Your days and notes side by side
tour.calendar.sub: See the year at a glance, then plan the day hour by hour.
tour.calendar.tick1: Year and month views with a day timeline and a live “now” line.
tour.calendar.tick2: Timed and repeating notes — daily, monthly or yearly.
tour.calendar.tick3: Your device’s calendar events beside your notes, if you turn them on.
tour.calendar.tick4: Add a note to your device’s calendar as an event, from the note’s menu.
tour.journal.title: A chat with yourself
tour.journal.sub: Drop thoughts, links and media as quickly as sending a message.
tour.journal.tick1: Messages, photos, videos, voice and files in one stream.
tour.journal.tick2: Live links to your notes, projects and tables.
tour.journal.tick3: Reply, edit, search and browse media and links in tabs.
mock.journal.msg1: Idea: a reading tracker table for 2027
mock.journal.msg2: Started it, first ten books in
tour.projects.title: A code editor in your pocket
tour.projects.sub: Write a web page, run it and let the AI help — nothing to install.
tour.projects.tick1: Start from a guided demo with styles, animations, console and libraries.
tour.projects.tick2: Edit like in a code editor: file tree, tabs, highlighting, error hints, auto-format, themes.
tour.projects.tick3: Run it instantly with a console that points to the file and line of each error.
tour.projects.tick4: Share: export a .zip or a picture of the preview, or embed it in a note or diary page.
tour.tables.title: Spreadsheets that feel familiar
tour.tables.sub: Formulas, sheets and charts that behave the way you expect from Excel.
tour.tables.tick1: 37 functions, references across sheets, fill handle, sort and filters.
tour.tables.tick2: Cell styles, number formats, merged cells, find and replace, undo.
tour.tables.tick3: Charts: bar, line, area and pie, with several series and trend lines.
tour.tables.tick4: Export to Excel with real charts, or a chart as a picture.
tour.backup.title: Yours to keep
tour.backup.sub: Your data lives on your device, and moving it is one file.
tour.backup.tick1: Backup to a single file — notes, diary, journal, projects, tables, media and settings.
tour.backup.tick2: Restore on a new device or after reinstalling.
tour.backup.tick3: Reminders for timed notes and gentle daily nudges, all optional.
tour.backup.tick4: Light and dark themes, 12/24-hour time, six languages.

privacy.title: Your data, your device
privacy.lead: The short version of our Privacy Policy.
privacy.device.title: Stored on your device
privacy.device.text: Notes, diary, journal, projects and tables live on your device. Use Backup to keep a copy. Your AI chat history is also stored on our server.
privacy.ai.title: AI only with your permission
privacy.ai.text: The chat sends what you write or attach to our server and to Anthropic’s Claude model — only after you allow it. You can withdraw it in Settings → Privacy.
privacy.ads.title: No ads, no selling
privacy.ads.text: We don’t show ads, sell your data or track you across other companies’ apps and websites.
plans.title: Free and paid plans
plans.manage.title: Manage or cancel
plans.manage.text: On iPhone or iPad: Settings → your name → Subscriptions. Cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends to avoid renewal.
plans.restore.title: Restore purchases
plans.restore.text: On a new device, sign in and tap Restore purchases on the Subscription screen.
plans.terms.title: Terms
plans.terms.text: Using Mind Hub means accepting our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
support.title: Support
support.lead: Answers to common questions. Can’t find yours? Write to us.
support.move.q: How do I move my notes to a new device?
support.move.a: Open Account → Backup and export a backup file. On the new device, sign in and restore it from the same screen.
support.ai.q: Why does the AI chat ask for permission?
support.ai.a: To answer, the chat sends your messages and attachments to our server and to Anthropic. We ask before anything is sent, and you can turn it off any time in Settings → Privacy.
support.limit.q: I reached the AI limit. What now?
support.limit.a: The allowance refreshes over time. Paid plans have a larger allowance.
support.password.a: On the sign-in screen tap “Forgot your password?”, enter your email and the code we send you, then choose a new password.
support.delete.q: How do I delete my account?
support.delete.a: In the app open Account → Delete account and confirm. This deletes your account, chats, messages, attached files, usage and subscription records from our server, and the data stored on that device. Can’t open the app? Email support@mymindhub.app from your account’s address. Deleting the account does not cancel a subscription — cancel it in your App Store subscriptions.
support.contact.title: Contact us
support.contact.text: Questions, bugs or ideas — we usually reply within a few days.
